8vc._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md §8). 8VC's rows arrive from four renderings of one book — the 2016-2021 WordPress cards, the 2022+ Webflow cards, the Form D issuer names and the recall layers — and three classes of duplicate follow. RENAMES the layers read directly (Acryl Data/DataHub, Orca BioSystems/Orca Bio, Zenreach/Adentro, Quaestor/Standard Metrics, AnchorFree/Pango, RelateIQ/SalesforceIQ). LEGAL ENTITIES that no listing ever used (National Resilience for Resilience, sp0n for Citizen, InboxApp for Nylas, Mulberry Health for Oscar, Nest Healthcare for Nest Health, BespokeLabs.AI for Bespoke Labs). And the firm's OWN SLUG VARIANTS across site eras, including one outright typo ('filedguide' for Fieldguide). Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed, else the last rendering — which is why AMP's canonical is the site's own opaque slug 'aimip' rather than the readable 'amp'.

merges.reason: Myeloid Therapeutics rebranded as CREATE Medicines on 2025-10-06 (PR Newswire); the 2022 archive lists the old name and the live site the new one, so one position was carried as two rows. Canonical is the live rendering; the entry and graduation decided on the Myeloid row were recorded on 'create' before the fold (ingest prep, 2026-09-24).
Acryl Data, the company commercialising LinkedIn's open-source DataHub, renamed to DataHub in 2025; the archive holds the old slug and the live site the new one.
Orca BioSystems Inc is Orca Bio's former registered name; same Menlo Park Form D filer, Alex Kolicich on the 2020q3 $192M round.
National Resilience, Inc. is the legal entity behind the listed 'Resilience' row; Drew Oetting on its 2021q1 $755M Form D.

merges.name: Nest Health
merges.reason: Nest Healthcare, Inc. is the legal entity of the archived 'Nest Health' listing; Sebastian Caliri on all three filings.
BespokeLabs.AI, Inc. is the Form D issuer for the live 'Bespoke Labs' listing; Bhaskar Ghosh on the 2024q2 seed.
sp0n, Inc. is Citizen's legal entity (the app launched as Vigilante); Joe Lonsdale and Jake Medwell on its filings.
InboxApp, Inc. is Nylas's original registered name; the same San Francisco filer carries both, with Lonsdale on the 2017q3 round.
Mulberry Health Inc. is Oscar Health's legal entity; its 2015q2 $134.9M Form D is the Formation 8-era evidence that decides the row under Delta A.

merges.name: Adentro
merges.reason: Zenreach rebranded to Adentro in 2021; Lonsdale on the 2017 and 2018 filings, Alex Kolicich on the 2023q4 one.
SalesforceIQ is RelateIQ under its post-acquisition name; 8VC's own site listed both spellings in the 2016 and 2022 captures.

merges.name: Pango
merges.reason: AnchorFree merged with TouchVPN and Betternet into the Pango group in 2019; one position, two listings.
Quaestor rebranded to Standard Metrics in 2022; the same San Francisco filer and the same 8VC seat (Alex Moore, Deny Khoung, Joe Lonsdale).
Wispr AI is the corporate name, Wispr Flow the product; the archive lists one and the live site the other.

Canonical is the site's slug because that is where the row is still published.
